title: Count while the values split
hook: Values move into partitions, but a range still needs an address.

knows: Compare numbers; read a short array, string, tree or graph as drawn.
doesNotKnow: Answer range counts using stable value partitions and prefix ranks in a wavelet tree.

misconception: A value partition loses the original interval positions.
objective: Answer range counts using stable value partitions and prefix ranks in a wavelet tree.

claims.text: Stable partitioning preserves relative order inside each child. Prefix counts map both original interval endpoints into that child, so a contiguous range stays addressable even though the values have moved.
